text: At 65 minutes, Redmond Rovers change their approach on the synthetic pitch. They press higher up the field and play more direct, quick passes to break down Ironvale Athletic’s low block. This adjustment increases their presence in the penalty area and tilts play significantly into Ironvale’s half. Despite lower possession, Redmond make a more aggressive push to score. [#1190]
